scope_reasons.object-level/G: general-purpose, control-flow, hardening or NOP-class form (X0 category G). X2's T1 judges intrinsic-level IR (ROADMAP §3.3; DR-008 step 2), where scalar C integer operators are QF_BV terms with C semantics (TABLE-SCHEMA §8.1) and control flow is the loop structure (RULES.md §5); this form exists only in compiled objects and is consumed by the B1.5 object audit (DR-008 step 3)
scope_reasons.object-level/S: non-FP SIMD or opmask form that no intrinsic of the T1 hosts denotes (a compiler's choice: moves, spills, legacy SSE integer and logic code in the scalar variants, broadcasts lowered from set1, opmask moves, VZEROUPPER). FP-insensitive by X0's frozen classification; it exists only in compiled objects and is consumed by the B1.5 object audit (DR-008 step 3)
scope_reasons.object-level/S, T1-image iclass: non-FP SIMD form of an iclass that intrinsic_map.v1 names. The census form is the compiler's encoding (memory operand, VEX/EVEX, width); T1 consumes the intrinsic's own register form, whose entry is written before T1 accepts code containing it (TABLE-SCHEMA §8.1) and fuzzed under rows generated by budget_rows at its frozen hash. The census form itself is consumed by the B1.5 object audit
